title: Dontcry ( Official )
description: This is a mod pack for the dontcry mod , there is a lot of mods , performance mod , horror mods etc
body:
DontCry is an atmospheric horror modpack built around the DontCry mod. The world feels familiar at first, but the longer you survive, the more things begin to feel wrong.

Dense fog, realistic sounds, dark forests, abandoned structures, and unexplained events will keep you constantly looking over your shoulder.

This modpack focuses on tension rather than constant attacks. The fear comes from what you hear, what you think you saw, and what might be watching from the darkness.

Remember:
If you think you saw something...
Don't Cry.
